low_power_modes: Sleepy End Device: RFD sleeps between polls / beacons to save battery
Beacon-enabled inactive period: coordinator/devices sleep between superframes
TRX_OFF: transceiver powered down when neither RX nor TX is needed
fields.notes: Ultra-low-power operation is a core 802.15.4/Zigbee goal: duty-cycled radio, sleepy end devices, and superframe inactive periods minimize average current for battery nodes.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
